correctness.rationale: The bridge sample space and normalization are explicit. Hypergeometric increment covariance gives the unconditioned energy. Catalan first-return generating functions give conditional mean energy ∑_i M_i(2M_i−1); independent fair excursion signs give conditional mean squared occupation ∑_i M_i², proving all semilength-vector cases. A marked excursion generating function establishes the count covariance for every n; finite exact tests passed 1,267 assertions.

value.rationale: The all-compositions conditional equality transfers covariance of any measurable excursion-length statistic between geometrically different natural bridge observables. This is a structural renewal-functional identity, not just one marginal Catalan coefficient or a routine finite enumeration. The exact negative return-count dependence illustrates its mathematical use.
